title: Sheet Pan Harissa Chicken with Chickpeas and Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 pounds boneless chicken breasts or thighs
ingredients.name: boneless chicken breasts or thighs

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup olive oil plus, more for drizzling
ingredients.name: olive oil

ingredients.raw: 2 lemons, juice and zest from 1 + 1 sliced
ingredients.name: lemons

ingredients.raw: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1 inch chunks
ingredients.name: sweet potatoes

ingredients.raw: Plain greek yogurt and fresh mint or cilantro, for serving
ingredients.name: greek yogurt and fresh mint or cilantro

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.

On a rimmed baking sheet, combine the chicken, 2 tablespoons olive oil, the lemon juice, lemon zest, harissa seasoning, honey, and a large pinch each of salt and pepper. Toss well to evenly coat the chicken. Add the sweet potatoes, onions, and chickpeas, and toss with the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil, along with another pinch of salt and pepper. Arrange everything in an even layer. Add the lemon slices and then transfer to the oven. Roast for 40-45 minutes, tossing halfway through cooking until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are golden.
Meanwhile, combine the feta, olives, and a drizzle of olive oil in a bowl.
To serve, top the chicken with the feta, olives, and yogurt. Sprinkle with mint or cilantro. Enjoy!
